parameters.name: DeliveryName
parameters.description:
The name of the log delivery configuration.

> This parameter is required when you enable log delivery by setting **Status** to **true**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: The protected object for which you want to modify the log delivery status.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to enable log delivery for the protected object. Valid values:

- **true**: enables log delivery.

- **false**: disables log delivery.
